name: LIFDelayedBank4
adaptation: Four independent leaky integrate-and-fire neurons with signed INT16 persistent membrane M[i] (units 1/256), initially zero. Every accepted input supplies four signed INT16 currents I, four unsigned beta bytes B representing B/256, and four unsigned 16-bit thresholds T=max(1,threshold_lane). Read old membranes, or zeros if in_clear=1. For each lane, old_spike=1 iff old M>T (strict, using this request's threshold). Let L=round_nearest_ties_away(B*M/256). Compute U=clip(L+I-old_spike*T,-32768,32767). Store U and emit a spike iff U>T. A spike therefore subtracts a threshold on the NEXT accepted step, not this one; at most one threshold is subtracted per step, even for a large membrane. There is no refractory period or clock-driven leak. Output bits 63:0 hold four stored membranes; bits 67:64 hold the four spikes. This preserves snnTorch Leaky's default delayed subtract-reset order. Fixed-point leak rounding, finite saturation, packed four lanes and positive-threshold normalization are declared adaptations, not floating-point bit identity. All parameters are per-request; in_clear discards old membranes before integrating the supplied currents.
